content: Diabetes Self-Management Education and Support (DSMES) programs are specifically developed to provide patients with the critical skills necessary to effectively manage their diabetes on a daily basis. These programs have been shown to lead to significant improvements in overall health outcomes, including better management of diabetes-related complications. Participation in DSMES programs has also been associated with higher levels of patient satisfaction, as individuals feel more empowered and confident in their ability to manage their condition. Furthermore, these programs contribute to improved glycemic control, helping patients maintain blood glucose levels within target ranges and reducing the risk of long-term complications associated with poorly controlled diabetes.
